svg.title: The annotation: one label curve per output channel
svg.desc: Left: the three label shapes, Gaussian, triangle and box, with their width label_sigma_s. Right: a window with one event and its targets, one row per output channel of the model: P and S curves at the picks, and noise as 1 minus their sum.
svg.text: One row per output channel, matched by the model's labels (PhaseNet: PSN)
